## About Me

:::::: about-section

:::: about-main

<p class="about-lead">
I am <strong>Md. Foysal Uddin</strong>, a student of <strong>Applied Statistics and Data Science at the University of Dhaka</strong>. My studies have introduced me to statistics, data analysis, programming, and computational thinking.
</p>

<p>
My interests include <strong>data science, statistical computing, backend development, and database systems</strong>. I enjoy working with <strong>Python, R, SQL, C, Stata, and SPSS</strong>, and exploring how programming and data can be used to solve practical problems.
</p>

<p>
I have a strong passion for <strong>learning, building, and exploring</strong> in these areas. I hope to keep developing my skills through hands-on projects and discover meaningful ways to bring statistics, programming, and data together.
</p>
